issues.description: The Bitmap24::save() method has a return-type mismatch in the template: the header declares 'int save(const std::string &i_filename)' but the implementation defines 'void Bitmap24::save(...)'. The solution repository uses 'void save(...)' in the header. This inconsistency in the template will cause compilation/type errors and confuses students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp in the template from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' so it matches the implementation in Bitmap24.cpp and the solution's header. This preserves the intended API and avoids compilation errors.

issues.description: The Bitmap24::save method is declared with a different return type in the template header compared to its implementation and the solution header. In the template repository header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) save is declared as returning int, while the implementation in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp (both template and solution) and the solution repository header declare/define save as returning void. This mismatch between the template header and the implementation/solution header creates confusion for students mapping the API declaration to the provided implementation and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and implementation consistent. Change the template header declaration to match the implementation/solution (use void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)) so the header and implementation/supplied solution refer to the same API signature.
